prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily forward across a rugged, rocky terrain under a night sky. The camera continues its steady advance, occasionally panning slightly to the left or right to reveal more of the desolate landscape, emphasizing the vastness and emptiness of the area. The overall effect is one of serene solitude, as the viewer navigates this remote and untouched natural setting in the heart of Mýrdalssandur, Southern Region, Iceland.
